name: 多肽保湿补水精华水款
description: 多肽精粹保湿补水、水润透亮、清透不黏腻的精华水套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: ice-blue #DDEEF9 gradient panels and cloud white #FFFFFF, with soft water-ripple and floating droplet accents
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio lighting, front or front-left key, gentle water-gloss highlights, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: smooth wet-look water surface and clean matte panels
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep navy #1F4E79, all copy wrapped in 「」, sub-labels in the same family
styleLock.iconSystem: rounded water-drop chips, dashed circle labels and thin-line icons in the single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright product presentation at a consistent scale across the set, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent hydrating skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ice-blue #DDEEF9, cloud white #FFFFFF, ocean-blue accent #1E73BE and deep navy text #1F4E79; bright soft diffused studio lighting with gentle water-gloss highlights and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep navy #1F4E79; consistent rounded water-drop chips, dashed circle labels and thin-line icon style; clean high-end skincare photography blended with light water-ripple infographic elements; stable upright product presentation and scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 开场一秒传递水感补水的核心利益，赢得点击
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a subtle low angle, product upright and centered, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright soft diffused studio light, front key with fill, gentle water-gloss highlights, soft contact shadow
shots.background: ice-blue gradient #DDEEF9 melting into #FFFFFF with a shallow water-ripple base
shots.props: floating water droplets and clear bubbles around the product, never covering the label
shots.textZone: top center headline 「{callout_1}」 in #1F4E79, plus two small round water-drop badges 「{selling_point_1}」 and 「{selling_point_2}」 floating beside the product
shots.promptTemplate: Product hero photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product standing upright and centered, photographed straight-on at eye-level with a subtle low angle, full product visible and filling 50-60% of the frame. Bright soft diffused studio light with a front key and gentle water-gloss highlights, a soft contact shadow where the product meets a shallow water-ripple base. Background an ice-blue gradient #DDEEF9 melting into #FFFFFF, with floating water droplets and clear bubbles around the product that never cover the label. Top center headline 「{callout_1}」 in #1F4E79, plus two small round water-drop badges with short labels 「{selling_point_1}」 and 「{selling_point_2}」 floating beside the product, the whole frame reading as one finished balanced composition. 8K, commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logos, no hands, no model face, no dense body text, no invented efficacy claims, no garbled text, no watermark, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 从 7 张爆款保湿水详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌、原文案、会员推广角标与二维码，产品一律以 {product} 占位；源图中的功效词（紧致/抗皱/提亮等）未写入模版，全部改为 {selling_point}/{callout} 占位；信任镜以真实瓶身正背面与精华液体质感微距呈现，不生成任何证书徽章。
